covers: The Yamaha YM3526 (OPL1) FM synthesizer as a chip

entries.name: YM3526 OPL
entries.description: Yamaha FM synthesizer, the first OPL: nine two-operator channels, a rhythm mode and two timers, programmed through an address port and a data port.
entries.behaviour: A write at offset 0 selects a register and a write at offset 1 sets it. A read at offset 0 returns the status: bit 7 interrupt, bit 6 timer 1, bit 5 timer 2, bits 2 and 1 always 1, the rest 0. A read at offset 1 returns 0xFF, and no register can be read back.

handlers.read: status read at offset 0, 0xFF at offset 1
handlers.write: register select at offset 0, register data at offset 1
